public.text: Appendix F provides useful detail on semantic-governance capabilities, but it does not restate clearly that SGI is an institutional and operational framework supported by tools, rather than a single software platform.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a prominent introductory statement: “SGI is a coordinated set of governance, people, processes, artefacts, and supporting technologies. It is not a separate software product or mandatory central platform.”
